integrity.computational_scope: all 1417 faces and 4608 Hasse cover relations of this finite complex
integrity.proof_kind: exhaustive acyclic face matching, topological sort, signed fixed-face Lefschetz traces and exact character arithmetic

scientific_limitations: Only the six-leaf bidirected complete bipartite graph is proved; no all-width result.

No equivariant homotopy splitting is claimed.
Independent mathematical review has not been performed.
title: The 169-sphere multipath complex of bidirected \(K_{2,6}\) and its full \(\mathfrak S_6\)-character
